_comment_secrets: NEVER put an API key in this file - it is committed to a public repo.
OpenCode substitutes {env:VAR} and {file:path} at load time, so reference
Keys added via `opencode auth login` are stored separately in
Underscore-prefixed keys like this one are comments; JSON has none.
_comment_usage: This file is symlinked to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by
scripts/65-opencode.sh, so edits here take effect immediately and are
tracked in git. Full key reference: https://opencode.ai/docs/config/
Common additions: model, provider, agent, mcp, permission, formatter, lsp.
